system.description: The Crossbow loader specialty lets the person load their crossbow faster. The loading time for a crossbow is reduced by -1 per level, but never lower than 1 in a combat round. and to attemt risky things. They receive an additional +1 Combat Point per level to distribute on their combat actions during an action round. The person also gets +1 per level in initiative in combat.
system.summary: Reduces the time needed to reload a crossbow between shots.
